component.name: LINTO
component.summary: Prepare, simulate and plot vector graphics on pen plotters
Vektorgrafiken für Stiftplotter vorbereiten, simulieren und plotten

description.p: LINTO is a slicer, layout editor and streaming controller for HP-GL pen plotters, from vintage machines like the Mutoh XP-500, HP 7585B or Roland DXY to modern drawing robots that speak HP-GL.

ul.li: Place SVG and HP-GL artwork on DIN A4 to A0 or custom sheets, with the plotter's real margins
Optimize pen paths to cut down pen-up travel
Simulate the whole plot on screen before drawing, including pen-up moves and estimated time
Map stroke colors automatically to up to 8 pens, with speed and force per pen
Stream to the plotter over RS-232 or TCP with hardware flow control, pause, resume and safe abort
26 device profiles and a built-in plotter emulator for trying LINTO without hardware

screenshot.caption: Layout mode: arrange, scale and map artwork to pens
Output mode: path optimization, simulation and plotter control
